dataList.content:
Your head... What an odd power it has. Just like the peculiarities of each Whale.
那个脑袋……确实有不可思议的能力啊。简直和鲸一样。
dataList.place:
Rendezvous Area Before the Heart
心脏前的集合点

dataList.content:
... Pequod crew sank. Right before heart.
……裴廓德号的船员们。沉没了。在心脏前面。

Because of you.
因为你。

It was a mistake to expect even a hint of surprise or shame from the Captain...
她害船员们丧命的事情暴露后……

... when it was revealed that she'd sent her crew to their deaths.
本以为她会感到一丝慌张或羞愧，看来只是我的错觉。

Hahahaha!
哈哈哈哈！

Yes, you can say that. You may indeed claim that I have sacrificed my crew.
是，你可以说是我让船员们牺牲了。

By now they must be wandering the Whale's guts, transformed into Mermaids. Lucky ones probably turned to sludge in acid.
恐怕，是在哪里变成了人鱼，运气好的话是被胃液溶解了吧。

But why...
为什么……

I know this heart better than anything else in the world. I know it better than my own body. The pancreas we have journeyed through is an endlessly winding maze! And if our limbs were to be melted off, we'd have no means of recovering them as you do.
我对这颗心脏的了解甚于自己的身体。我们通过的胰腺是一座无尽蜿蜒的迷宫！并且，我们手脚溶解后无法像你们一样恢复。

I had to calculate the ideal path to the heart, losses be damned. I see no injustice committed in my pursuit of practicality.
我必须计算出到达心脏的最优路线！这有问题吗？

I even encouraged and reminded them of their pride and greatness as they drew their last breaths.
在他们死前，我还在提醒他们铭记自己的荣耀与伟大。

When it could not be helped, I made sure that they perished before fear overwhelmed them.
如果做不到，我会在他们感到恐惧前给他们一个痛快。

My crew and I are one, bound by oath! The promise that we will hunt the Pallid Whale, whatever it takes!
他们对我立下过誓言。直到捕到白鲸之前，对一切都有所觉悟！

Are we not, Ishmael?! Now, we shall...
以实玛利！我说得没错吧？我们现在……

... Sail... to the heart?
……必须去……心脏？

Quite! Yet we need one last piece of the puzzle before we set sail.
没错！为此，我们还要做最后一件事。

Ahab turns to face me again, glaring at me with her burning eyes.
亚哈闪闪发光的眼睛再度看向我。

That shard of the Bough.
那块碎片。

<What are you...>
<你说什么……>

I, Captain Ahab, cannot be deceived! That thing in your clock-head... is a piece of that Golden Bough, is it not? It is that Golden thing that counteracts the Pallidification effects! Am I wrong in assuming that this is how you and your crew have remained untouched by its effects?!
没人能骗过我亚哈的眼睛！你脑袋里装着的，是能够中和白化现象的金色碎片之一。我有猜错吗？所以你们才没有变成人鱼！

Soon, our final battle for everything that we hold dear will commence. And for victory, I shall spare no quarter.
我们之后，要将一切投入最终决战。

No one knows what will happen here, at the heart of the Whale from which all evils of the City, the world, spout.
在那头身为这世间与都市中万恶根源的，充满憎恶的白鲸的心脏里，不知道会遭遇什么。

And is it not patently clear that you are the only one inexperienced in combat?
并且很明显，在我们之中最缺乏战斗经验的就是你。

What if you were to perish...? What fate shall befall your crew?
那么，万一你在途中死去……剩下的船员们会怎么样？

What fate shall befall your crew, should you meet a pathetic end without having destroyed the Whale's heart!
如果还没能破坏心脏，你就卑微地断气了，之后会怎样！

<That's...>
<那是……>

Everyone here, including your crew and mine, will turn into Mermaids within hours.
你的船员不必多说，我的船员们也会在数小时内变成人鱼吧。

<So... what the hell do you want me to do?>
<所以……你想让我怎么做？>

Hand it over. That golden shard in your head.
将你脑袋里的金色碎片献给我。

And I swear by my name that I will personally see to it that everyone trapped within this Whale safely makes it to the world outside.
那样一来，我会担起全部责任，负责让幸存的所有人出去。

Captain ain't wrong, you know...
说的……很对，船长。

<Huh. I guess that makes... some sense.>
<哈。我差点也认同了，在那么一瞬间。>

It takes but a single sacrifice... to ensure that everyone survives. Down to every single crew.
只需要一人牺牲……其他人就能平安脱身。直到不剩下任何一名被留下的可怜船员。

I... I detest that. I shall not relinquish Manager Esquire's head to thee...!
吾不赞同，吾不想把经理老爷的头交出去……

Then what? Fail to destroy its heart and let us all be Mermaids together? Is that how you wish your tale to end?
这么说你是想选择无法破坏心脏，大家一起变成人鱼的结局？

That's...
那……

My friends. Is there not something out there, past this Pallid Whale's flesh, that awaits your return?
你们所有人，都有活着离开这里的理由吧？

Laying your lives down just to save the life of some useless clock cannot possibly be your dream.
为那个钟表头卖命就是你们的人生目的吗？

You must have something that drives you! A desire, a goal, a mission that you must see to its end once you escape this Whale!!!
每个人都该有从这里出去后想要实现的东西吧！！！

Captain Ahab cuts through our hearts, cracking them little by little, and nests in there.
亚哈船长在人们心中制造出缝隙，随后将其缓缓扩大。

Even the Sinners may have been moved by her speech, even for a brief moment.
或许罪人们，也在一瞬间心生动摇。

And that brief moment is all it takes for that thought to spread through the heart as water freezes between the cracks of a rock.
一旦出现的缺口使得想法被侵染，便会趁心灵脆弱时不断扩散。

That's what she's always done, I'm sure.
这就是她一直以来的做法吧。

And all of a sudden, when everything reaches a crescendo... it will shatter.
随后，在关键时刻将其引爆。

Ishmael. Her crew. This is what Ahab had done to them...
不管是以实玛利，还是其他船员。都是这样……

<Tell her what I'm about to say, Faust.>
<帮我传话，浮士德。>

Understood.
我明白了。

<You're not going to be responsible for the Sinners.>
<你绝不可能对罪人们负责。>

<And no one knows what'll happen to the Sinners if my head is crushed.>
<并且破坏我的头后，没人知道罪人们会如何。>

<I'm not going to let the doubts you cast chart our futures.>
<我无法将所有人的未来托付在这种不确定的方式上。>

<Because I am their Manager.>
<因为我是执行经理。>

Ooh…
嚯……

Hmph, predictable. Pleading for your life now, are you?
哼，意料之中。你是在惜命吗？

<Besides... I don't want to die.>
<而且……我不想死。>

Sacrifice. A gilded name given to death so that it won't feel as hollow when it claims us.
牺牲这种词只是虚浮的装裱，好让死亡不再毫无意义。

I've seen the Sinners die a thousand deaths. And I've shared that very same pain that killed them countless times.
无数次旁观罪人们的死，无数次让他们复活，与他们共享痛觉的我对此一清二楚。

I've felt the weight of their every death... so I can't bring myself to wrap them up in a pretty box labeled 'sacrifice'.
我对他们每一次的死亡之重感同身受……因此我无法将他们的死亡包装在贴上“牺牲”的标签的漂亮盒子里。

Instead, I endure. Endlessly.
相反，我会永远承受。

What gives our collective struggle significance, what gives our suffering meaning... is us. We share the weight and convey our own meanings to our battles.
为了真正地为他们的苦难赋予意义，只有一同承受重担，并为他们所有的战斗赋予意义一途。

So that everyone can reach for their own dreams.
正因如此……每个人才都能如愿以偿。

That's why this struggle is no sacrifice.
这就是这场斗争并不等于牺牲的原因。

I won't seek death willingly.
我并不会主动地寻求死亡。

Ahab... You really haven't changed. ... No, you've become even more revolting.
亚哈……你还是老样子……不，你甚至变得更加令人厌恶……

I struggled, I thrashed, yet... Again, you had us in the palm of your hands…
我挣扎过，我抗争过，但是……又一次，你将我们玩弄于股掌之间……

Commandeering our ship, turning me into one of your crew again…
又一次擅自作为船的主人，在不知不觉中把我们当成你那艘船的船员……

Silence!!! Shut up. This... is a moment of paramount importance.
肃静！！！闭嘴。现在……是最为重要的时刻……

The path to the heart opened as Ahab finished her words.
话音落地，通往心脏的道路洞开了。
